title: a build in the user folder ~/.jitso/builds is listed with its origin, and launches with the layer on its card header
source: intended: builds come from layers (repo, trusted parent folders, user folder), nearest wins (docs/decisions.md)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-12, build layers). Builds come from layers, nearest first: the project's jitso/builds, each trusted parent folder, then the user folder ~/.jitso/builds. A user build that is valid for this project is listed by build list with ` (from user ~/.jitso/builds/<file>)` after its summary line, a build of the project itself has no suffix, and launch accepts it (the dry run card header ends `build <id> v<n> (user)`).

stdout.regex: (?m)^- shared-scan: claude-haiku-5-5 low\. Scan the repo for shared settings and report them\. requires: nothing \(from user ~/\.jitso/builds/shared-scan\.yaml\)$
